claims.text: On the generality axis: their account holds that T ranges over PGL(4,R); the group is derived from four perceptual postulates (central projection, coherent updating, minimal gauge, normative control); trika-x holds that sigma has exactly two values, asserted, not derived. This matters because this is the strongest mapping in the set and the clearest gap: our flip is the two-element degenerate case of their group action.

On the derivation axis: their account holds that RP^3 and PGL(4,R) are necessary given P1-P4; trika-x holds that two positionings are stipulated (tier H, owner framework). This matters because they prove a necessity claim; we assert a two-valued structure, so ours is weaker and more general.

On the formality axis: their account holds that continuous geometry plus active inference, not machine-checked; trika-x holds that machine-checked but finite and discrete. This matters because complementary: their structure, our kernel check.

Their formalisation is: The Projective Consciousness Model (Rudrauf, Williford and colleagues): conscious experience as a world model transformed by a projective transformation, S = T ∘ R, with viewpoint changes acting as collineations in PGL(4,R) (Williford, Bennequin, Friston & Rudrauf (2018) Front. Psychol. 9:2571; Rudrauf et al. (2023) Brain Sci. 13(10):1435; Rudrauf & Pansu (preprint) 'Why the PCM must be true' (verified 2026-11-17)). Recorded as published; not re-verified by this essay.

Our side is anchored in machine-checked structures: Inexternalism.lean :: mode_switch_preserves_content, Inexternalism.lean :: recognise_preserves_content, PerspectivalAction.lean :: act_preserves_content. Registry references are not source-to-theorem entailments.
Shared ground: a content/positioning separation: a fixed world-model R plus a perspective T applied to it.
Shared ground: change is a transformation of access, not a change of content.
Shared ground: experience is perspectival by construction.

What it means: The upgrade path is half-built: the discrete skeleton (group laws, generator, joint testbed) is machine-checked. What remains is the continuous group and its derivation from postulates. Do not claim the fit until then.
